purpose: Fit the already-selected and protected-holdout-validated baseline recipe on all 707 approved training observations for competition inference. This is separate from selection of new campaign-02 model changes.
source_provenance_note: The original training run predates launch-time source logging; its source snapshot was captured before holdout evaluation, as already documented. The current pinned baseline implementation and all recorded recipe fields are unchanged.
validation_scope: Protected holdout PQ 0.346248 belongs to the original 399-image checkpoint. It supports the selected recipe; it is not a held-out score for this all-data refit. Never evaluate or report the original holdout as independent for this checkpoint.
gates: Require exact parent recipe/source equivalence, all approved and no external training observations, successful new-checkpoint CPU inference and fresh canonical replay, valid CSV and complete coverage, exact artifact hashes and quota check. Do not reuse the original checkpoint-specific gate record.
new_model_comparison: New architectures/reconstruction changes still require the separate campaign-02 grouped comparison before promotion.
